name: user-scanner
description: 🕵️‍♂️ (2-in-1) Email & Username OSINT suite for deep data extraction just from a single Email/Username. Analyzes 465+ actively maintained scan vectors (175+ email / 290+ username) for security research, investigations, and digital footprinting.
one_liner: A tool that takes an email address or username and checks hundreds of websites to find where that identity has accounts.
buyer: A licensed private investigator or a corporate trust-and-safety team doing legitimate background or fraud checks.
business_use_cases: A fraud-investigation team cross-references a suspicious account's footprint across platforms during an internal investigation.
A journalist verifies a source's online identity before publishing a story.
A corporate trust-and-safety team checks whether a reported user has a pattern of abuse across services.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'digital footprint report' service strictly to licensed investigators, with legal review of every request.

steal_this: Be honest with yourself: packaging this as a consumer 'find anyone' product runs straight into privacy law and platform terms of service — not a good weekend business.
